purpose: Manual visual standard for later independent comparison with the main pipeline. It is not an electrical diagnosis, Labelme annotation, or training label.

annotation_protocol.input: Raw right.png versus raw wrong*.png pairs only.
annotation_protocol.unit: one independently visible connected local change group
annotation_protocol.rule_for_global_ai_rerender: Do not invent local boxes. Mark the image as not eligible for local-box statistics when broad scene or viewpoint regeneration prevents isolating a local edit.
annotation_protocol.important_caveat: This pass intentionally did not reopen algorithm output, but the annotator had viewed candidates earlier in the session. It is manual-only for this pass, not a strict double-blind study.

metric_policy.future_comparison_requirement: Do not expose candidate output while this manual standard is being reviewed or revised.

images.manual_observation: Broad text, component-detail, and framing variation; no one local connected change can be isolated reliably.

groups.description: White conductors visibly appear or are rerouted below the upper-left black contactor.
A connected bundle of white conductors visibly runs from the upper terminals down toward the lower-right rail.
A white conductor is visibly added or rerouted in the upper-middle terminal-row area.
Adjacent dark module or breaker faces visibly replace the reference arrangement in the upper-middle row.

images.manual_observation: The whole cabinet is reframed and rendered differently; local changes cannot be separated from the global regeneration.
Global cabinet framing, component detail, labels, and wiring appearance vary together.
Global cabinet framing and broad component rendering differ; no isolated local group is reliable.
Whole-scene geometry and broad device or label appearance vary together.

groups.description: A blue conductor visibly hangs below the upper-right terminal row.
groups.excluded_reason: The rest of the cabinet is globally regenerated, so this box is review evidence only and not eligible for geometry-based coverage scoring.

images.manual_observation: One local blue-conductor difference is clear, but the global rerender prevents treating this image as a fair local-detection case.
Whole-scene framing and broad panel rendering differ; no isolated local ground-truth group is reliable.
Global scene and component appearance variation prevents a defensible local-box standard.
Whole-scene viewpoint and many device details differ together; do not force separate local labels.
